digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output parsing / completion verification
propositions: The completion verifier returns a DEPENDENCY-LINK record (Dep) instead of a CompletionVerdict, causing fail-closed rejection of legitimate close transitions.
The root cause is schema-blind selection in tolerant_parse: it returns the first JSON object that PARSES rather than the first that SATISFIES the target schema CompletionVerdict.
When the verifier quotes a Dep record from show_ticket results in prose before its verdict, that record is selected as the structured output because it appears first in document order.
The defect is triggered by parent-child relationships with depends_on links in the ticket graph, which causes the verifier to call show_ticket and quote the raw JSON Dep in its reasoning.

Schema-filtered candidate selection must enumerate all candidates (fenced blocks, top-level objects), screen by key-overlap against model_cls.model_fields, validate each survivor, and select the LAST valid candidate, with fallback to current pipeline on no winner.

The fix architecture spans three layers: provider-native output where measured (Layer 1), prompted-path hardening with sentinel channel and schema-filtered selection (Layer 2), and invariant tests plus artifact capture on failure (Layer 3).
